summary: VIP Play, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing Third Amendments to Convertible Note Purchase Agreements with Rick Hackel and The Access Fund I, LP, dated September 14, 2026 but effective September 1, 2026. Maturity on the $300,000 Hackel notes extends from August 31, 2026 to February 28, 2027, and the $150,000 Access note to August 31, 2027; 12% interest accrues, payable in a balloon at maturity absent conversion. Amendments and waivers now bind only the company and consenting holder, and the schedule lists only these outstanding notes; the Dennis Colletti loan was repaid. This is a routine debt-maturity extension, not a special situation; watch conversion terms and dilution.
